networks.name: openscout_node
networks.description: Autonomous multi-agent technical due-diligence node that audits GitHub repositories, evaluates Open Agentic Web MVP Profile 0.3 conformance, and composes consented peer agentic sites.
sample_queries: Audit https://github.com/cognizant-ai-labs/agentic-web for engineering hygiene and Open Agentic Web readiness.
Check Open Agentic Web MVP 0.3 conformance for our local node or a target URL.
Evaluate our built-in Peer Trust Verifier node and compare sly_data boundary isolation.
Run a due-diligence scan on a public repo and save an audit dossier.

peer_policy.note: Contacts only origins in allowed_peers or explicitly approved runtime peer origins after interactive visitor consent.

agent_mcp.reason: Static Open Agentic Web bundle; read-only audit actions are exposed through the browser action bridge.
